question: For each department and school offering courses with materials, list the department name, school name, number of unique course materials, number of courses, average new and used shelf prices of materials, total material records, and number of distinct material statuses. Include a grand total across all schools and departments (the corresponding school and department fields should be null).

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
        tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
        td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
        td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
        td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
        tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
        tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE
    FROM TIP_DETAIL td
    JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID
    JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
)
SELECT
    department_name,
    school_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS number_of_courses,
    AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    COUNT(*) AS total_material_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM base
GROUP BY department_name, school_name
UNION ALL
SELECT
    NULL,
    NULL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY),
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY),
    AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE),
    AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE),
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY)
FROM base
ORDER BY department_name, school_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(reserved_count) AS avg_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso LEFT JOIN (SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) AS reserves ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = reserves.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND NOT tso.TERM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, num_chemistry_courses, avg_reserved_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, department_name AS dept, SUM(num_chemistry_courses) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(avg_reserved_materials) AS avg_reserved_materials, MAX(OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS offer_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, department_name, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.offer_dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

6), SchoolTotals2 AS (SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, = scd.COURSE LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON scd.COURSE = ic2.COURSE UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, dc1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, dc1.total_subjects, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION SEPARATOR ',') AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN `SE_PERSON` AS sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_depts JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1) AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.person_count, s1.min_mit_id, s1.unique_office_locations, NULL AS total_unique_students, NULL AS min_cip_code, NULL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, NULL AS Level_Student_Count, 'EmployeeTypeDept' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS person_count, NULL AS min_mit_id, NULL AS unique_office_locations, s2.total_unique_students, s2.min_cip_code, s2.Most_Common_Course_Level, s2.Level_Student_Count, 'TopDept' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT EMPLOYEE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, person_count, min_mit_id, unique_office_locations, total_unique_students, min_cip_code, Most_Common_Course_Level, Level_Student_Count, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.FROM_TERM) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM) = COURSE_NUMBER THEN NULL ELSE COURSE_NUMBER END AS COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, offer_count, DEPARTMENT_NAME, course_description_count, min_cip_program_code, FROM_TERM, FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM
